title: The Cutting Edge: Week of September 20th
body:
**Highlights**
- [’Exchange C](https://gov.edgewa.re/proposal/discussion/1005-proposal-exchange-c-edg/)’ aka [Kucoin Exchange has listed Edgeware](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1442088882909052931?s=20)'s native token $EDG.
- [The first on-chain bounty is proposed for 500k EDG](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1441141675569541126?s=20) to improve and fix known issues in the upcoming Wako upgrade. 
- All validators are requested to upgrade their nodes to the [release v3.3.3 or later](https://github.com/hicommonwealth/edgeware-node/releases) to proceed further with the ERUP4/Wako upgrade through the on-chain governance. The core community dev Ramsey recently shared [the docker image for v3.3.3 aka ERUP4/Wako upgrade](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1438226365833175048?s=20) to save the compiling hustle for node/validator owners.
- Get to know more technical oriented updates on the ‘[EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-dev-digest-sep-19/)’.


**Ecosystem Updates**
- Community members interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink’s oracle nodes on Edgeware, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community members interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)’s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb.tools.
- Commonwealth partnered with [Fei Labs and Frax Finance](https://twitter.com/hicommonwealth/status/1440081181110726656?s=20).
- Kylin CSO, [Dylan Dewdney talked at Nasdaq marketplace](https://twitter.com/Kylin_Network/status/1440367678607167489?s=20).


**Governance**
- No active referendum. Upcoming: [ERUP4/Wako upgrade](https://gov.edgewa.re/proposal/discussion/1100-erup-4-substrate-30-evm-updates-runtime-modules)


**Community**
- The Calendar of events has many items each week, meetings on NFTs, DAOs, chain strategy and governance- whatever you're interested in, [take a look](https://gov.edgewa.re/proposal/discussion/1059-edgeware-community-calendar-add-to-your-gcal).
